name: Material Comp
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: values are 0-1 positions, read through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

Ratio shows the other way round ("1:4.0" for 4:1). Threshold, ratio, attack, release, input, output and Master Mix carry; the Auto Attack/Release switches, preamp, glue, punch, knee and side-chain settings come back as you left them.
No in/out: Material Comp has two parameters both called Bypass.
